The retained T16 chronology originates in PR3413 and is preserved in our PR3457/3465 provider-composition lineage. T16-PROVENANCE.json pins the actual PLAN and reconstruction source. This contribution supplies the combined chronology and newly solved allocation; it does not claim the constituent chronologies or count their prior gains twice.

Private optimizer tools are excluded. New material is Apache-2.0, prepared for hexapode with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.
